keys.description: Percent window animations run at: 100 as shipped, 200 twice as fast, 50 half as fast
Background painted on every surface not set on its own (panes, desktop, window chrome, dock, rail): off (your terminal shows through), theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name)
Colour overriding the focused pane's border: #89b4fa, a slot name such as bright_cyan, or a role such as accent
Two or more colours, separated by spaces, that the focused pane's border steps through. Empty draws one colour
Direction of the focused border's gradient in degrees: 0 runs left to right, 90 top to bottom
Border style drawn around every pane
Colour overriding an unfocused pane's border: #585b70, a slot name such as bright_black, or a role such as muted
Go time layout the clock is drawn with, e.g. 15:04 or Mon 3:04PM
Background behind and between panes, including gaps and an empty workspace: off, theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name); empty follows appearance.background
Let dim_unfocused dim a pane's text too, not only its background
Dim the panes in the multifocus set like other panes you are not in
How much tuios fades a pane you are not in, as a percent. 0 is off.
Background under the dock: off, theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name); empty follows appearance.background
Draw the dock as one row with no rule. The panes get one more row
Icon in the mode pill in terminal mode. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
Icon in the mode pill while tiling is on. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
Icon in the mode pill in window mode. An empty value shows no icon. default uses the icon of the glyph set
Draw rounded caps on every dock pill: the mode chip, the workspace tabs and the minimized windows. Off draws flat pills
Where the dock shows an armed leader key: pill colours the mode pill, badge draws a separate badge
Cells a workspace pill's label may span before the pill cuts it (0 draws the whole name and scrolls the strip instead)
Workspace tab template accepting {index}, {name}, {icon} and {zoom} (empty: {name})
Show the clickable workspace strip in the dock
Edge the dock sits on, or hidden
What a BSP drag shows where the pane would land: a frame with a tint inside, the frame only, or nothing
Cells of empty ground kept between two neighbouring tiled panes
Chrome glyph set: the characters the border, controls, rules and rail marks are drawn with
Hide the scrollbar thumb on the pane border
Hide the minimize, maximize and close buttons
Side the master panes take in the master-stack layout. Center puts the stack on both sides.
Width of the master pane in the master-stack layout, as a percent of the screen
How much the screen behind a modal panel is darkened, as a percent. 0 is off.
How much moves: none, basic (window slides and the copy sweep), or full (also overlay fades and the working-agent shimmer)
Background behind pane content: off, theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name); empty follows appearance.background
Columns of padding each side of an overlay panel's content
Width of a column in the scrolling layout, as a percent of the screen
Hairline thumb over the content column, or a full-height track
One-cell glyph for the thumb. Empty uses the style's own.
Bar colour: quiet, border, muted, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name)
One-cell glyph for the track, or none. Empty uses the style's own.
Background behind selected text
Draw selected text bold as well as tinted
Background of the copy mode cursor block
Text colour under the copy mode cursor. Empty keeps it.
Selected text colour. Empty keeps the colour it already has.
Sweep a band of light over text that was just copied. Set motion to none to turn it off.
The light the copy sweep is made of
Milliseconds one copy sweep takes
The shape the copy sweep takes
Background behind the match the cursor is on
Text colour of the match the cursor is on. Empty keeps it.
Background behind every search match
Text colour of a search match. Empty keeps the colour it has.
Carry the session's colour on every pane border, not only on the rail
Give each session its own colour on the rail and in the switcher
Draw one border between neighbouring tiled panes, in every layout
Show the clock overlay
Show the CPU graph in the dock
Show RAM usage in the dock
Background under the rail: off, theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name); empty follows appearance.background
Space between the rail's sections: normal, or roomy for a blank row in front of each section after the first
Show the session rail
Draw each file icon in its file type's own colour
Draw a nerd font icon per file type in the files section
How the rail's section headers read: lowercase keeps the quiet furniture look, uppercase draws them as headings
How a rail section header is drawn: auto, plain, rule, pill, or icon with the section's icon
Scroll a hovered row's overflowing title
Edge the rail sits on, or hidden
How the rail marks the row you are on: bar in the gutter, marker glyph, underline, or pill
Section names in the order the rail stacks them, each with an optional percent share. A name left out is a section the rail does not draw, and "spacer" is an empty block you may repeat.
Show the window count on each session row
Show the agent-state glyph on each row
Show the switch number ahead of each session name
Preferred rail width in columns on a wide screen
Colour theme name. Empty follows Omarchy when it is installed, else keeps your terminal's colours. none always keeps them.
Theme to use while the terminal is light. Empty uses theme for both. theme is then the dark theme
How tuios shows a theme change: none, circle (the new theme grows from the middle of the screen) or fade
Milliseconds a theme transition takes at animation speed 100
Which end of the title bar the window controls sit on
Window controls as a filled pill or as macOS traffic lights
Background under pane borders, title bars and the lines between shared-border panes: off, theme, or a colour (#rrggbb, 0-255, a slot name or a role name); empty follows appearance.background
Where a pane's title sits on its row. auto keeps it away from the window buttons
Title template accepting {title}, {index} and {cwd}
Edge of the pane the title is drawn on
Shape of a pane's title: pill has rounded caps, tab is a plain fill, plain is the text on the border
When window borders are hidden: never, always, or while the mouse is idle
Slide a pane between its tile and the zoom box instead of swapping the two in one frame
Width in cells of a zoomed pane. 0 fills the screen.
How much of the screen a zoomed pane takes, as a percent. Below 100 the layout around it stays visible at the edges.
The built-in cells in the middle of the dock, in order. An empty list draws nothing there.
Go time layout the clock renders in (empty means 15:04); a layout without seconds refreshes once a minute
The built-in cells on the left end of the dock, in order. An empty list draws nothing there.
The built-in cells on the right end of the dock, in order. An empty list draws nothing there.
Background colour of the flat tab of the current workspace
Draw the flat tab of the current workspace in bold
Text colour of the flat tab of the current workspace
Text after the label of a workspace whose pane printed since you looked. Empty shows none.
Text colour of the tab of a workspace with a pane that waits for you
Text after the label of a workspace whose pane rang the bell. Empty shows none.
Background colour of the flat tabs of the other workspaces
Draw the flat tabs of the other workspaces in bold
Text colour of the flat tabs of the other workspaces
What {icon} in appearance.dock_workspace_tab_format shows for each workspace, the first item for workspace 1. A workspace past the end shows its number.
Text between two flat tabs. Empty is one blank column.
Colour of the text between two flat tabs
Keep the + tab in the flat style
How the workspace strip draws its tabs: pill, or flat for coloured runs of text
What {zoom} shows on the tab of the current workspace while a pane in it is zoomed
Percent of its light an unlit cell loses
Cut the beam at its edge, or fade it out. A fade sends about three times the bytes each time the beam moves
Light one part of the screen and dim the rest
Half the beam's height, in rows
Tiling scheme a new session starts in. An existing session keeps its own.
Start a new session tiled instead of floating. False when the config file has no [startup] table.
